items.title: AMD Sinks 13%, Bloom Energy Down 18% as Midterm “Seismic Shift” Deepens Chip Sell-Off
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD fell 13% today, with Intel and Bloom Energy also lower, on fears that Democrats’ midterm sweep will slow the AI data-center build-out. AMD had no news of its own, two days after a strong quarter and a forecast for 80%-plus revenue growth in 2027.

items.title: A $2.4 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysHeard Capital, a $2. 4 billion fund, opened new positions in Bloom Energy (BE:NYSE), Marvell Technology (MRVL:NASDAQ), and added 25% to its AeroVironment (AVAV:NASDAQ) stake in the quarter ended June 30, according to its latest 13F.

items.title: Bloom Energy Sinks 8%, Lumentum Down 11% as AI Power Stocks Fade After Democrat Sweep
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy fell 8% as AI stocks sold off after Democrats swept Tuesday’s elections, and Lumentum and MARA Holdings fell with it. Data center contractors fell even more, a sign investors fear fewer data centers will get built, which would hurt Bloom too.
